fact: The Ministry of Agriculture, through SADP II with WFP, supported a weather-index agricultural insurance pilot in Mafeteng, Mohale's Hoek and Quthing in the 2025/2026 season, in which satellite observations monitored crop water availability, with more than US$1.2 million insured.
title: Beyond the harvest: can agricultural insurance protect Lesotho's smallholders?
